items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: They'd all get their instruments out and just play to Dick. Every 10 or 11 o'clock in the day, they'd still be blowing at one another. And that's Dick.

ctx.x: The Waggon Top was on St. Peter, between Marie and Liberty. There was a shed where they used to keep horses years ago. And stables, you know? They'd fix it up and open up a ballroom in there. They had a bandstand in there. These fellas would knock off and wait. They'd have their jam session in there. They'd all get their instruments out and just play to Dick. Every 10 or 11 o'clock in the day, they'd still be blowing at one another. And that's Dick. I had some other questions.
I wondered if you could tell us a little bit about drummers. Since you were a drummer, who were the best drummers? Who did you like? And who helped you and all that on drums?
